item.title: Silent Book Club Montclair — Wed Dec 16, 5:00 PM — Montclair Public Library
item.description:
At Silent Book Club® there's no assigned reading. SBC members gather in bars, cafés, bookstores, libraries, and online to read together in quiet camaraderie. All readers are welcome—ebooks or audiobooks, poetry or prose, fiction or non-fiction... it's BYOBook.
Did you love silent reading time in school? Are you more of an introvert that loves books, but doesn't want to jump into a discussion group? Are you looking to read more, but struggle to sit down and just DO IT? If you answered 'yes' to any of these, you might like Silent Book Club! Each month, we meet around Montclair and enjoy each other's company with a book of our own choosing.
Registration is required.
Please be advised this book club will be meeting at a public location and therefore cannot guarantee a quiet reading environment. This book club is best for readers who enjoy a coffeeshop ambiance (low chatter, music, outside noise, etc.) or those who prefer to read with headphones.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

Love books and making things? Join the Make Something Book Club, a relaxed gathering where participants can chat about the books they're currently reading while working on a creative project. Bring your knitting, crocheting, needlepoint, embroidery, cross-stitch, quilting, or other portable craft and enjoy conversation with fellow readers and makers.
There is no assigned book—everyone is welcome to share what they're reading, discover new titles, and connect with others in the community while creating something by hand.
Bring a project you're working on, or start something new! Thanks to generous donations from our community, we'll often have a small selection of craft supplies available to share, though materials will vary from meeting to meeting. If you have a specific project in mind, we encourage you to bring your own supplies.

item.title: First Day Phillipsburg Easton Hike! — Fri Jan 1, 9:00 AM
item.description: Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us for this big loop hike featuring Easton and Phillipsburg! It has become a tradition doing this area as part of the New Year, starting it off right with walking! This year, we'll do trails and historic sites all around both Easton and Phillipsburg, and we'll start in Easton at the Giant Supermarket just off of Sullivan Trail. We'll walk some back streets for a bit tracing the historic route of the area trolley. This will lead us into Gollub Park where we will visit the former site of the Paxinosa Inn, and then make our way down along the trolley bed as it weaves around past St Anthony's Nose, then return to the streets. We'll pass through the college campus and down the giant steps that have been repaired recently, then head across the Rt 22 bridge to Phillipsburg. item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Dec 9, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Memory Café - A Dementia-Friendly Social Gathering — Mon Dec 14, 11:30 AM — Montclair Main - Auditorium
item.description:
For adults with dementia and their caregivers, this event offers a welcoming, safe, calming space for socializing, music, art and reminiscing every month.
A “Memory Café” is a dementia-friendly social gathering for individuals with early-stage memory loss or mild cognitive decline and their care givers.
The meetings will be held in a safe and comfortable environment where people can interact and socialize with others having similar experiences. At the gatherings participants can get support in a non-judgmental setting, while enjoying the benefits of music for the brain.
The meetings will be run by Lisy Espindola, LCSW and Kim McLennon, MSW and music therapist. Lunch and/or snacks will be served.
This is a joint program between Lifelong Montclair at the Township of Montclair and the Montclair Public Library.
Attendance is free but registration is required. Questions? Call 973-744-3278.

item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Mon Dec 7, 8:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Awakening Awareness: Embracing This Moment (1 hour) — Tue Dec 8, 8:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream Feel free to join as we get still and practise presence within this moment. We will discuss and observe the obstacles that, seemingly, block us from being present and bring awareness to our unconsciousness in a safe, inclusive and affirming way.
Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teaching and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous.
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys has been passionate about mindfulness since 2010 and since 2021 he has been organising free, weekly online meditation groups. For more information on his free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group, visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/).
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Mah Jongg Meetup - Weekly Monday Morning — Mon Dec 14, 11:00 AM — Montclair Bellevue Avenue Branch
item.description:
PLEASE NOTE: You must sign up for EACH INDIVIDUAL SESSION. Signing up for one session does not register you for any following classes.
The Mah Jongg Meetup provides a weekly opportunity for players to continue practicing their established skills, sharpen their strategies, build confidence at the game table, and socialize with fellow Mah Jongg players!
The library will provide a set and table! NOTE: Attendees should already have an understanding of the Mah Jongg game. Attendees should bring their 2025 or 2026 National Mah Jongg League card to the meetup. Bringing an additional set is encouraged!
There is also "Mah Jongg Meetup - Weekly Thursday Morning". If you are interested, please register here.
If you prefer to play the game on the weekend, please register for the "Mah Jongg Meetup - Weekly Saturday Afternoon" by clicking here
If you're new to the game, and would like to teach yourself at your own pace, please register for the "Teach Yourself Mah Jongg" by clicking here.
Sour

item.title: Teach Yourself Mah Jongg - Weekly Monday Morning - NEW — Mon Dec 14, 11:00 AM — Montclair Bellevue Ave Branch - Classroom
item.description:
The Teach Yourself Mah Jongg provides a weekly opportunity for teaching yourself the basics of American Mah Jongg at your own pace.
The library will provide the book Beginner's Guide to American Mah Jongg by Elaine Sandberg, Mah Jongg card, a set and table! You can also boost your learning with a list of Mah Jongg resources available at the library.
After you know the basics of Mah Jongg, and would like to play the game with other Mah Jongg players, please register for the weekly Thursday or the weekly Saturday "Mah Jongg Meetup".

item.title: YOUTUBE/FACEBOOK - MICHAEL SHAWN AND THE TAKEOVER LEGENDS PODCAST: WEDNESDAY WORD — Wed Jan 6, 8:00 AM — NJ
item.description:
Every Wednesday at 8 AM on Michael Shawn & The Take Over Legends, Lady Renaissance (aka KT) brings the poets to you! The Wednesday Word is a live weekly segment featuring some of the dopest poets in the spoken-word community — for raw interviews, panel discussions, and conversations that go beyond the page. Curated by Kierstin Tonic (Lady Renaissance), co-founder of Lyrics To Go and curator of community arts spaces, The Wednesday Word is where the open mic meets the podcast. Live. Unfiltered. On purpose. Catch it live every Wednesday at 8 AM on YouTube and Facebook — or catch the replay and share the word! Source: NJ Poetry Events
